candidates: When a keyboard shortcut is displayed in the UI (e.g., hint text like 'Ctrl + Enter'), verify that the corresponding Vue event handler actually fires on all advertised platforms before merging. The `@keydown.meta.enter` modifier only triggers for the Meta key (Cmd on macOS) and does NOT cover Ctrl on Windows/Linux — if Ctrl+Enter is also advertised, a separate `@keydown.ctrl.enter` binding is required. Manually test the shortcut on at least one non-Mac platform (or a Ctrl-only context) to confirm it works.

Use the semantic `<kbd>` HTML element to mark up keyboard key names in user-facing UI text (hints, labels, tooltips) rather than plain `<span>` tags or bare text. For example: `<kbd>{{ ctrlSymbol }}</kbd> + <kbd>Enter</kbd>`. This conveys correct semantics and accessibility meaning; add scoped CSS to adjust sizing if the default monospace styling clashes with the surrounding design.
